capabilities: Plan books, scenes and story elements
Draft chapters and compile Markdown manuscripts
Organize workspaces, tasks and reading study
Connect optional AI, translation and speech services
disambiguation: Despite its name, it is a broad writing suite, not a minimal note-taking plugin.
extras: API keys are stored in local settings rather than an encrypted vault; protected notes leave filenames visible and lost passwords cannot be recovered.
problem: Obsidian lacks a single workspace for long-form book planning, drafting, review and manuscript compilation.

relations.evidence: Correct editor targeting, selected native preferences, native suggestion actions and narrow-screen tooltip styling.
Native source-control/history views and commands checked against the running backend.
Its native conflict, diff and configuration dialogs. This companion is not a synchronization engine.
Basic supports OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq Cloud and compatible custom endpoints.
DeepL and Google Cloud use their official API keys.

summary: Customizable writing workspace for planning, drafting, revising and compiling Markdown books and notes.
